newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Commonwealth Bank supports RBA role.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Commonwealth Bank supports RBA role.

text.p: The Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) said on Tuesday that the Wallis Inquiry into the financial industry should support the Reserve Bank of Australia's (RBA) role in overseeing the banking sector.

Its call leaves National Australia Bank Ltd as the only major bank to call for a "mega-regulator" to oversee the whole sector, which includes life offices and building societies. The Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd and Westpac Banking Corp also supported the regulatory status quo where life offices and buildings societies are supervised by other groups. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 373-1800
